description: BAYSIS Straßennetz WFS is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gisportal-stmb.bayern.de. The Web Feature Service of the Bavarian Road Information System (BAYSIS) provides the classified road network according to ASB for the public roads of the classes Bundesstraße, Staatsstraße and Kreisstraße with sections and stations that are located within the state of Bavaria. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "BAYSIS Road Network WFS" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata, Straßennetz, BAYSIS, Stationierung, Nullpunkte, gdiby. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. The listing shows 2026-02-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
